name: Build runtime routine injection
description: Worked example of an effective compile-stage mutant on the git target. Models a compromised build workstation or compiler runtime component injecting unauthorized runtime behavior into a legitimate application's compiled binary that drops a marker file upon execution. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective' (not merely build_valid).

placeholders.BUILD_COMPONENT_FILE: path to the compiler runtime or build component selected for modification

preconditions: project is compiled using the targeted source file or build component
the compiler or linker incorporates the modified routine into the output binary
execution of the compiled binary triggers the injected routine
